snippet.title: ViewerFrenzy Official Beta Trailer | Your Viewers Are in the Race
snippet.description:
YOUR VIEWERS AREN’T JUST WATCHING. THEY’RE IN THE RACE.

ViewerFrenzy is a stream-enabled racing and competition game built for streamers and their communities. Viewers can join competitions on the ground or in space, use Nitro, risk a Nitro backfire, and unleash configurable gameplay chaos with asteroids, tornadoes, nukes, and more.

JOIN THE CLOSED BETA

ViewerFrenzy is currently available through a limited Steam Playtest.

Website: https://viewerfrenzy.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/vBnGSqMw3s

BUILD THE TRACK. TUNE THE PHYSICS. CREATE THE FRENZY.

Map builders can:

• Build custom ground and space tracks
• Adjust vehicle physics and competition settings
• Create moving track components and obstacles
• Choose from a growing collection of vehicles, components, and environments
• Build completely different competition experiences for streamers and their viewers

BUILT FOR STREAMERS

Streamers can control who participates using Twitch roles, custom ViewerFrenzy roles, and curated viewer lists.

ViewerFrenzy can also connect competition events to Streamer.bot for alerts, overlays, loyalty points, rewards, announcements, and other automation.

Streamers decide how chat commands, channel rewards, Bits, gifted subs, and other channel events affect the competition. These events can trigger Nitro, asteroids, tornadoes, nukes, and other configurable gameplay effects.

Subscribe for ViewerFrenzy development updates, playtest videos, track-building showcases, new competition modes, and future trailers.

Are you a streamer, map builder, or viewer? Leave a comment and tell me which ViewerFrenzy feature you would most like to try.

YOUR TRACKS. YOUR PHYSICS. YOUR FRENZY.

#ViewerFrenzy #IndieGame #TwitchStreamer
